scenes.title: Where and when
narration: Tsyganochka originated in Russia in the 19th century, evolving from a melody composed by Ivan Vasilievich Vasiliev, director of a Russian Roma choir.
The melody 'Gypsy Vengerka' was based on a poem by Apollon Grigoriev, a fan of Romani music.
The dance developed without a fixed choreography, becoming popular among Russian Roma choirs and folk performers who added a recognizable refrain.

music_brief.prompt: Original instrumental composition in the musical world of Tsyganochka (Russia). Meter 4/4. Instruments: guitar. Vocal style: includes a recognizable refrain added by folk performers. Form: melody with slow introduction and accelerating tempo. Mood: minor key, expressive, dynamic. It should sound like this: A minor key melody in 4/4 time, starting slow with a guitar base, featuring a folk refrain and gradually increasing tempo, evoking a dynamic and expressive mood. New melody, new arrangement: do not quote or imitate any specific recorded song; keep the idiom, the instruments, the pulse and the proportions.
